lines.x: Two Russian missiles and a drone landed in southeastern Poland during a 110-missile barrage against Ukraine that killed eight people in Kyiv.
XTB shares fell more than 6% from Wednesday's open, extending Tuesday's sell-off triggered by the Polish financial regulator KNF's announced intervention on CFD contracts.
NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte affirmed alliance commitments to defend Polish territory after two Russian cruise missiles and a drone crossed into Poland's airspace.
Hungary's foreign minister Anita Orban called the Russian incursions into Polish airspace a serious threat to European security, as other European countries condemned them.
